The Scalloped Upholstered Kids Bed is a softly upholstered children's bed with a curved, shell-inspired headboard and fully enclosed side panels. It is handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Curved shell-inspired scalloped headboard
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Solid, sturdy frame
  • Handmade to order in West Yorkshire, UK
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a wooden frame that is fully upholstered. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress. If you are unsure which mattress suits your size, especially the Kids Single (2.6FT), call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Is it suitable as a first proper bed?

It is designed as a comforting, fully upholstered bed with enclosed side panels, in Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT).

How does it compare with the Shell Panel Kids Bed?

Both have a curved, shell-inspired look. See the Shell Panel Kids bed to compare.

What sizes does it come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT), all at £299.00.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.

Related: kids beds.

p1.descriptionHtml:
Soft curves, a sculpted silhouette and plush velvet: the Seraphina Scalloped Velvet Bed brings one of the most-wanted headboard shapes of the year into your bedroom. Its tall headboard is formed from rounded, shell-like panels, each one padded and upholstered by hand in our West Yorkshire workshop.

Key features

  • Statement scalloped headboard with deep, rounded panels
  • Plush velvet upholstery in your choice of colour
  • Deep, fully upholstered base that sits neatly to the floor, with no exposed legs
  • Handmade to order, so it can be adjusted to suit your room
  • Comes with a wooden slatted base

Materials and build

Built on a wooden frame and fully upholstered by hand. Free fabric swatches are available so you can see the colour in your own light before you order.

Sizes available

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT), Standard Double (4FT6), King (5FT) and Super King (6FT). Need a different size, headboard height or an ottoman storage base? Ask us about a bespoke version.

Mattress compatibility

Takes a standard UK mattress in the size you choose. Browse our pocket sprung, memory foam and pillow top mattresses to complete the bed.

Delivery

Free delivery to addresses across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Let us know about stairs or tight access when you order.

Care

Vacuum gently with a soft brush attachment and blot any spills straight away with a clean, damp cloth.

Backed by our 5-year warranty. Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

p3.descriptionHtml:
The Side Lift Open Ottoman Bed is a fully upholstered gas lift ottoman bed that opens from the side, handmade to order by our family-run team in our Dewsbury workshop. It suits rooms where the foot of the bed sits close to a wall or furniture, as long as you have clear floor along the opening side, and anyone who wants large storage under the mattress. Sizes: Single 3ft £415.99, Small Double 4ft £454.99, Double 4ft6 £493.99, King 5ft £532.99 and Super King 6ft £636.99. Delivery is free across Great Britain to your door by our own team. Order free fabric swatches to see your colour at home before you order.

Good to know

  • Free delivery across Great Britain to your door (downstairs) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland, Jersey, Guernsey and the Isle of Man: £90.
  • Room of Choice Drop Off: +£29.99. We carry it to the room you choose. Choose it under Delivery Service on this page.
  • Room of Choice Assembly: +£69.99. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99. Downstairs drop off stays free.
  • 14-day free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.
  • 5-year frame warranty.
  • Spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout, or pay by card or PayPal.
  • Free fabric swatches: Order free fabric swatches before you choose a colour. Using your own fabric? We accept it and will confirm the fabric quantity for your size.

Key features

  • Side-opening gas lift ottoman mechanism
  • Large underbed storage compartment
  • Clean modern upholstered design
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

Available in the sizes below, with prices from the current listing. Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

  • Single 3ft: £415.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £454.99
  • Double 4ft6: £493.99
  • King 5ft: £532.99
  • Super King 6ft: £636.99

Materials & build

Built on a wooden frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request, and free swatches let you check at home.

Storage

The gas lift raises the base from the side, opening a large storage compartment under the mattress for bedding, spare linen and seasonal clothes. Leave clear floor along the opening side and headroom above for the base to rise.

Mattress compatibility

Order the size that matches your mattress. Add our Memory Orthopaedic Mattress from £142.99 or 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress from £220.99 for a complete set.

Customisation

Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone fabrics, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches are available.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales) to your door (downstairs) by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days. Delivery to Northern Ireland is £90.

Changed your mind? You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) as long as the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. If anything arrives faulty we will arrange a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed also carries a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout.

Compare with the base-only Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base, or browse all ottoman beds. New to ottomans? Read how ottoman beds work.

FAQ

How does a side lift ottoman bed open?

Gas struts raise the base from the side, so you reach the storage without lifting the mattress off.

What sizes and prices are available?

Single 3ft £415.99, Small Double 4ft £454.99, Double 4ft6 £493.99, King 5ft £532.99, Super King 6ft £636.99.

How is it different from the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base?

Both open from the side on a gas lift. This one is listed as a full upholstered bed; the Side Lift Ottoman Storage Base is listed as a storage base. Compare sizes and prices, or call us to talk it through.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available, so you can check colour and feel at home. Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour.

What is your returns policy?

You have 14 days for free returns, with free collection, if the item is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund.

Side lift or end lift: which suits my room?

A side lift opens along the long side of the bed, so it needs clear floor on that side. An end lift opens from the foot, so it needs space at the foot of the bed. Compare both in our ottoman beds range.

Will you carry it upstairs and build it?

Free delivery is to your door (downstairs) across Great Britain. Choose Room of Choice Drop Off (+£29.99) and our team will carry it to the room you want. Optional room-of-choice assembly is available for £69.99. Both are picked under Delivery Service on this page.

Can I use my own fabric?

Yes, we accept customer-supplied fabric. Call or email us first and we will confirm the fabric quantity for your size.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
